const items = [];
console.log(items.length);
const index = 0;
items[index] = "a";
items[1] = "b";
items.push("c");
console.log(items.length, items.join(","));
const later = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
  if (later.length > 0) console.log(later[later.length - 1]);
  later.push(i * 2);
}
console.log(later);
